name: Eutre Hyte
source:
A centurion in the Belgerard army under Zaur's nominal command, he hires Judar to fight in the 13th Ustone Valley battle. A schemer who excels at disrupting enemy supply lines, his operation to burn the supplies of the invading Delphion army is a success thanks to Judar's heroics. Unfortunately Zaur's cowardice loses the battle before the lack of supplies can force the lifting of the siege. Nonetheless Eutre manages to negotiate with Dulphia; in exchange for sparing the lives of himself, Judar and the soldiers under his direct command he consents to all of them being sold as slave soldiers to Grasesta.

[Spoiler] Eutre does not join Judar initially. He spends time learning about his new environs and searches for a way to earn enough currency to raise himself and everyone else who came with him to free citizen status. Because the funds required are so overwhelmingly large, he pledges false fealty to King Salo and his trusted minister in exchange for performing clandestine missions at the king's behest. His efficiency at achieving results eventually wins him and his former subordinates free citizen status, although some of his underlings lose their lives in the meantime.

Eutre is the finalist of the Artisans tournament and offers Judar to throw the match in exchange for material reward equivalent to the champion prize money. If Eutre wins, he later offers Judar a mission which gives more background information on the diplomacy and politics of Grasesta relative to its neighbours.

Late in the tale, Eutre eventually betrays Lilica and Judar by attempting to steal the secrets of the Rinshi research and fleeing Grasesta. With the research he hoped to win back the favour of the Belgerard king and return to military service at his homeland together with his comrades. If Judar overcomes the betrayal and the royal forces who were aware of Eutre's betrayal, he is forced to fight alongside Judar for the duration until Lilica and Judar figure out a suitable punishment.

Eutre and his comrades are eventually exiled from Grasesta by the time of the coronation ceremony and are last seen escorting Kashram's merchant caravan. [/Spoiler]
